pairs.objectiveA: Find the first position with value at least a target, preserving a half-open answer interval.
pairs.objectiveB: Find the first position strictly greater than a target and distinguish it from lower bound.

pairs.objectiveA: Match a full string against dot-and-star patterns using zero-copy and repeat transitions.
pairs.objectiveB: Match glob patterns by letting a star consume zero or more arbitrary characters.

pairs.objectiveA: Find all pattern occurrences as one interval in lexicographically sorted suffixes.
pairs.objectiveB: Find the lexicographically smallest string rotation by skipping a run of losing candidates after a mismatch.
